apiQuery.matchingRule: Actual --find is substring lookup; extra matches are recorded, and the expected real Manifest asset must be present. No ranking or model-score inference.

browserAggregate.status: passed-scoped-Chromium24; isolated consumption scope remains2cases with completed12-capability three-instance local seams

threeInstanceConsumption.contractScope: All12 have actual three instances; managed assets consume existing APIs/styles, Table is explicit copy/fork. Native style overrides are not labeled named LocalRecipes.
threeInstanceConsumption.countedUnit: 12 capability examples × 3 host modes; composing Parts and nested ghost Bubble are not counted separately.

bubbleAdditionalAssertion.assertion: First BubbleContent local differs; default equals sibling, in both completed isolated cases.

directionAdditionalAssertion.browserAssertion: local has exactly one dir=rtl element; sibling has zero dir=rtl elements; no computed direction values serialized.

localIsolation.siblingGuarantee: Observed computed properties of default and sibling remain equal while local differs. No global token/UI source or shared CSS alteration. These properties/Dir and named interactions are covered, not every visual property or every behavior.
